parties: IRIS RegTech Solutions Limited; Deepta Rangarajan (acquirer/substantial shareholder)
headline: IRIS RegTech Solutions: Takeover disclosure filed under SEBI Regulation 31(4)
sum: Deepta Rangarajan has submitted a Regulation 31(4) disclosure to NSE, indicating a substantial acquisition of shares in IRIS RegTech Solutions Limited. The filing triggers mandatory takeover code compliance under SEBI's 2011 regulations.
implication: A Reg 31(4) disclosure signals crossing of a 5% or higher threshold; confirms acquisition trigger for open offer or exemption route-partner must verify threshold crossed, exemption basis, and timeline for mandatory offer notice.
detail: The NSE filing dated 22 Jun 2026 is a Regulation 31(4) disclosure under the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011. Deepta Rangarajan is the acquirer. The precise shareholding percentage, acquisition price, deal structure, and open offer timeline are not disclosed in the available public sources.
